title: Uruguayan Creamy Chicken Lasagna
description: A twist on the classic lasagna, featuring Uruguayan flavors and a creamy sauce.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to the package instructions.
Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Sear the chicken breast in a hot skillet until browned on both sides.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and bake in the oven until cooked through.
In a separate skillet, melt the cream cheese over low heat.
Stir in the luscious ricotta cheese and creamy grated Parmesan cheese.
Combine the cooked lasagna noodles, Uruguayan chicken breast, and creamy cheese sauce.
Transfer the lasagna mixture to a baking dish and top with additional grated Parmesan cheese.
Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let the lasagna rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
